scope: Diagnostic phase and complex NR/LAL comparison on existing amplitude-qualified nonspinning33 holdouts; no phase fitting, no runtime promotion

band.grid: highest resolution N3 native frequency grid, common domain of all variants; no extrapolation

fourier_convention.lal_mode_mapping: multiply by (-1)^3 for equatorial symmetry h3,-3=(-1)^3 conj(h33)
fourier_convention.time_reference: own h22 peak at t=0 for each waveform
fourier_convention.phase_reference: native SXS inertial phase retained; constant and linear-in-frequency residual removed only in explicitly aligned metrics

phase_alignment.fit: unwrap candidate/reference phase; weighted least-squares constant + 2pi*f*time; report raw, constant-only, affine residual
phase_alignment.tail_mismatch: full common band including weak tail, phase mask applies only to phase alignment

phase_quality_diagnostic_limits.interpretation: preregistered sensitivity thresholds, not rigorous error bounds; every case reported whether passing or failing

overlap.definition: absolute integral conj(candidate)*reference*exp(-2pi*i*f*time)/PSD divided by norms, maximum over time and constant phase
overlap.interpretation: single-mode ringdown-band-only mismatch, not full detector waveform mismatch

lal.role: post-freeze validation only; no LAL outputs or coefficients used to fit

calibration_policy: existing amplitude calibration remains frozen; all primary cases remain holdouts; no future fit of these data without explicit new split
failure_policy: record failures and preserve selection; no case replacement or threshold changes from residuals; preserve original freeze if amendment needed
